crossRefs.note: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who…
their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy, of…
The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence…
You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens.…

translations.web: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
translations.bsb: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
translations.kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
translations.asv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.
